import string
import sys
import curses
import curses.ascii
import curses.textpad

def _t():

    def check(func, expected):
        assert func(i) == expected, ('assertEqual', func(i), expected)
        assert func(c) == expected, ('assertEqual', func(c), expected)
    for i in range(256):
        c = chr(i)
        b = bytes([i])
        check(curses.ascii.isalnum, b.isalnum())
        check(curses.ascii.isalpha, b.isalpha())
        check(curses.ascii.isdigit, b.isdigit())
        check(curses.ascii.islower, b.islower())
        check(curses.ascii.isspace, b.isspace())
        check(curses.ascii.isupper, b.isupper())
        check(curses.ascii.isascii, i < 128)
        check(curses.ascii.ismeta, i >= 128)
        check(curses.ascii.isctrl, i < 32)
        check(curses.ascii.iscntrl, i < 32 or i == 127)
        check(curses.ascii.isblank, c in ' \t')
        check(curses.ascii.isgraph, 32 < i <= 126)
        check(curses.ascii.isprint, 32 <= i <= 126)
        check(curses.ascii.ispunct, c in string.punctuation)
        check(curses.ascii.isxdigit, c in string.hexdigits)
    for i in (-2, -1, 256, sys.maxunicode, sys.maxunicode + 1):
        assert not curses.ascii.isalnum(i), ('assertFalse', curses.ascii.isalnum(i))
        assert not curses.ascii.isalpha(i), ('assertFalse', curses.ascii.isalpha(i))
        assert not curses.ascii.isdigit(i), ('assertFalse', curses.ascii.isdigit(i))
        assert not curses.ascii.islower(i), ('assertFalse', curses.ascii.islower(i))
        assert not curses.ascii.isspace(i), ('assertFalse', curses.ascii.isspace(i))
        assert not curses.ascii.isupper(i), ('assertFalse', curses.ascii.isupper(i))
        assert not curses.ascii.isascii(i), ('assertFalse', curses.ascii.isascii(i))
        assert not curses.ascii.isctrl(i), ('assertFalse', curses.ascii.isctrl(i))
        assert not curses.ascii.iscntrl(i), ('assertFalse', curses.ascii.iscntrl(i))
        assert not curses.ascii.isblank(i), ('assertFalse', curses.ascii.isblank(i))
        assert not curses.ascii.isgraph(i), ('assertFalse', curses.ascii.isgraph(i))
        assert not curses.ascii.isprint(i), ('assertFalse', curses.ascii.isprint(i))
        assert not curses.ascii.ispunct(i), ('assertFalse', curses.ascii.ispunct(i))
        assert not curses.ascii.isxdigit(i), ('assertFalse', curses.ascii.isxdigit(i))
    assert not curses.ascii.ismeta(-1), ('assertFalse', curses.ascii.ismeta(-1))
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')

import curses
import curses.ascii
import curses.textpad

def _t():
    unctrl = curses.ascii.unctrl
    assert unctrl('a') == 'a', ('assertEqual', unctrl('a'), 'a')
    assert unctrl('A') == 'A', ('assertEqual', unctrl('A'), 'A')
    assert unctrl(';') == ';', ('assertEqual', unctrl(';'), ';')
    assert unctrl(' ') == ' ', ('assertEqual', unctrl(' '), ' ')
    assert unctrl('\x7f') == '^?', ('assertEqual', unctrl('\x7f'), '^?')
    assert unctrl('\n') == '^J', ('assertEqual', unctrl('\n'), '^J')
    assert unctrl('\x00') == '^@', ('assertEqual', unctrl('\x00'), '^@')
    assert unctrl(ord('A')) == 'A', ('assertEqual', unctrl(ord('A')), 'A')
    assert unctrl(ord('\n')) == '^J', ('assertEqual', unctrl(ord('\n')), '^J')
    assert unctrl('\x8a') == '!^J', ('assertEqual', unctrl('\x8a'), '!^J')
    assert unctrl('Á') == '!A', ('assertEqual', unctrl('Á'), '!A')
    assert unctrl(ord('\x8a')) == '!^J', ('assertEqual', unctrl(ord('\x8a')), '!^J')
    assert unctrl(ord('Á')) == '!A', ('assertEqual', unctrl(ord('Á')), '!A')
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    print('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    print('ok')
